title: Read the signal
intro: We will open a message from a kid, see what a bare chatbot says, and then see what your own assistant says.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing is sent. We open the Bringing humans closer tab.
Milo is 13. He sent his mom a picture of a capybara with the words: this is lowkey me.
A bare chatbot explains the words. It does not know Milo or his mom, so that is all it can do.
Now press Read the signal. Your assistant knows Milo loves capybaras and just started at a loud new school.
It says this is a shared laugh, and it says how sure it is. It is not a request for advice.
You get three short replies in your own voice. Pick one, or change it by microphone.
act: Love you, see you at dinner.

steps.say: The demo says nothing was sent. In the real dashboard, nothing is sent until you say yes.
That is the whole walkthrough. Press Replay to watch it again.
